title: Packed-Ensembles for Efficient Uncertainty Estimation
mechanism: Grouped convolutions pack M ensemble subnetworks into one network and one forward pass while keeping deep-ensemble diversity.
adaptation: Packed U-Net++ decoder (M=4, alpha=2) on RN34; one run gives an ensemble for deployment and an uncertainty baseline for the benchmark.
min_experiment: Arm: packed U-Net++, 3 seeds. Baseline: house single and 4-seed ensemble. Metric: crack IoU, ECE. Kill: below house single.
evidence: R: matches deep ensembles on accuracy, calibration, OOD detection and shift robustness within one network's memory.
